subject: Urgent: INV-7781 payment stalled — gateway chargeback / VAT evidence request
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@harrington-med.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: INV-7781 payment stalled — gateway chargeback

Mateo,

Quick heads-up — our AP team reports that the wire for INV-7781 was returned by our bank earlier today. Bank says a chargeback/authorization reversal was initiated on their side and funds are being withheld pending investigation. We attached the remittance they sent.

We need: (1) copy of the signed invoice and any proof of delivery of services, (2) VAT evidence for cross-border supply (Harrington entity needs confirmation to pass to treasury), and (3) contact at Redwood for bank-to-bank reconciliation.

This is putting us in a difficult spot because the service launch is due tomorrow and our internal auditors are asking for clear evidence to release funds. Can you escalate?

Attachment: Harrington_INV-7781.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Sven Lutz
Head of Procurement
Harrington Medical

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@harrington-med.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: INV-7781 payment stalled — gateway chargeback

Hi Sven — thanks for the flag and the remittance. I’m sorry for the friction here. I’ve pulled the file and can confirm the invoice (INV-7781) was issued to Harrington Medical on 2026-07-29 and shows services delivered on 2026-08-01. I’ve attached our payment statement and the original invoice.

What I’ll do now:
- Open a direct reconciliation with our payments ops and the bank (I’ll introduce them to your treasury contact).
- Share VAT documentation for the supply (we’ll attach the VAT certificate we have on file).
- Propose a 48-hour taskforce: Redwood payments ops + your treasury + our finance lead to get a bank trace and unblock the wire.

Can you share the bank contact (name/email/phone) handling the reversal? If Harrington can confirm a partial release or staged remit, we can propose a temporary allowance to proceed with the launch.

Attaching: payment_statement_INV-7781.pdf (pdf)

—
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
From: Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@harrington-med.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@harrington-med.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: INV-7781 payment stalled — gateway chargeback

On Sun, Aug 30, 2026 at 10:05 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sven — thanks for the flag and the remittance. I’m sorry for the friction here.

Mateo — thanks. Bank contact below:
Eve Ramos
Correspondent Bank Relations
CorrespondentBank EU
eve.ramos@correspondentbank.eu | +44 20 7946 0123

Our AP is prepared to release a partial tranche (30%) once we have a firm bank trace and Redwood confirms invoice authenticity and VAT documentation (they want to see VAT registration and a statement of cross-border supply).

I’m copying our accounts team on this thread. If we can get a short mutual action plan today, I can push a partial release as an interim step.

Best,
Sven

Attachment: bank_return_notice.pdf (pdf)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: INV-7781 payment stalled — gateway chargeback (Exec ask)

Team — looping in leadership since Harrington is requesting staged remit and we are within the 72-hour SLA window for launch. Quick bullets and ask:

- Situation: Bank returned the wire (chargeback). External treasury (Harrington) will consider 30% tranche pending bank trace and VAT evidence. If we cannot get funds cleared, product launch will be delayed and we face potential contract remedies.
- Risk: Reputational + potential credit hold; Harrington has strong enterprise presence in EU.
- Proposed Redwood path: offer staged remit (30% now, 70% within 14 days post-trace), require VAT registration and signed statement of supply from Redwood EU entity. Provide a short mutual action plan and a DocuSign amendment to payment terms.

Attachments: proposal_staged_remit.xlsx (xlsx) — includes suggested dunning cadence if tranche misses deadline.

Ask: Jonas / Marissa — please approve using staged remit as a concession and allow a 2-week collection runway (we will keep credit watch). If approved, I will coordinate DocuSign and notify legal for a limited-scope amendment.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sven Lutz <sven.lutz@harrington-med.com>, Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: INV-7781 payment stalled — gateway chargeback

Thanks all — quick status and mutual action plan below (agreed with Harrington accounts on a short call at 14:00 PT).

Mutual action plan (MAA):
1) Immediate: Harrington to send partial tranche (30%) to Redwood by EOD 2026-09-03.
2) Redwood to provide: signed invoice copy, VAT registration extract for Redwood EU entity, and bank account confirmation for trace (we will share the SWIFT trace within 24 hours of receipt).
3) Within 72 hours post-trace: Harrington to release remaining 70% or produce formal dispute paperwork to Redwood (if dispute persists, items escalate to legal).
4) If tranche fails to arrive by 2026-09-03 23:59 PT: Redwood will move to next-step dunning (automated reminders + credit watch) and schedule credit committee review (Kim/Marissa to lead).

Action items assigned:
- Mateo: send VAT extract and bank acct confirmation (attachment).
- Kimberly: prepare DocuSign amendment for staged remit and a short dunning cadence doc.
- Harrington (Sven/Eve/accounts@harrington-med.com): initiate 30% remit and provide bank trace contact details.

Links: HubSpot deal record https://hubspot.company/recs/DEAL-41259 | DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-8237

Attachments sent: payment_statement_INV-7781.pdf; Harrington_INV-7781.pdf; proposal_staged_remit.xlsx

If the tranche posts on time we’ll mark the launch green. If not, we’ll follow the dunning path Kimberly proposed and escalate to credit committee for a formal hold.

Thanks for the quick coordination — I’ll send the bank trace when it comes through.

—
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
